purpose: Group the 110 original grammar practice records by concept so sampling can avoid excessive near-repeats and expose coverage gaps.
sampling_policy: Do not treat unique IDs as proof of unique learning value.
Prefer concept diversity within a practice set.
Limit near-identical prompt patterns when enough alternatives exist.
Retain repeated concepts in the master bank because repeated practice is useful.
Do not delete or rewrite source questions during deduplication; apply selection metadata instead.
release_gate: Concept metadata is advisory until record-level canonical migration is complete; it must not alter source answers or official blueprint allocation.
